findings.title: Recoverable owner callback exceptions abort without draining active healthy children
findings.impact: progress() and other uncaught owner callback exceptions escape schedule; execute_owner only closes log handles. The owner can exit and PDEATHSIG-kill healthy children instead of draining as promised.
findings.proof: Real temporary direct children verified inherited PhaseLease. An injected status-storage OSError escaped while2healthy children remained running. The reviewer manually waited both exit0 to clean the fixture.
findings.fix: Turn recoverable callback errors into owner failure, stop new dispatch and keep polling/waiting every active child before returning or releasing owner scope.

findings.title: Owner cache-plan validation omits current GPU-bridge qualification/stage checks
findings.impact: A changed/revoked nested bridge qualification is accepted by runtime validate_plan while the accepted worker bridge guard rejects it. New workers will fail safely, but all-resume completion bypasses worker checks and can report operational completion under revoked bridge evidence.
findings.proof: Synthetic SHA-bound cache plan with unchanged permit/top4gates and deliberately changed bridge proof: owner validate_plan(initial=False) passed, gpu._bridge_gate rejected. Disk free was a synthetic boundary; no worker/GPU launched. All-resume implication was source-inspected rather than a real45-run launch.
findings.fix: Revalidate the accepted complete GPU bridge gate/current primary stage in owner preflight and each guard, including all-resume paths.

findings.title: Receipt context accepts noncanonical nonce and unverified phase owner/stage
findings.impact: A32-character traversal nonce can reference a different directory still inside root. Wrong phase_owner_pid and source-qualification primary_cache_stage_sha256 are ignored even when expected worker PID/nonce match. This weakens current-child and resume provenance. No root escape was observed.
findings.proof: verify_return accepted nonce ../+29chars and accepted a hex-nonce receipt with phase_owner_pid=-7 and wrong primary stage while expected PID/nonce/device matched. Only temporary synthetic metadata/marker hashes were used.
findings.fix: Require strict lowercase32hex nonce and canonical receipt path; bind typed positive current child/phase-owner identity and current qualification stage. Explicit resumes need equivalent SHA-bound prior context without requiring dead prior PIDs to remain live.

findings.title: Generic scheduler accepts more than4devices or duplicate physical indices
findings.impact: UUID uniqueness and index range alone allow5distinctUUIDs with repeatedindex and5simultaneous starts. Actual idle_devices is constrained by4configured UUIDs and native workers independently protect GPU0-3, so no real protected GPU access was demonstrated.
findings.proof: A fake completed-process provider with5UUIDs and indices0,1,2,3,0 started5jobs in the same fill step.
findings.fix: Require<=4devices, unique physical indices and UUIDs, and enforce the active cap defensively.
